server.name: montrose-mcp
server.title: Montrose MCP
server.description: Carnegie Montrose tools for accounts, holdings, credit, transactions, watchlists, and pre-filled trade tickets.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.title: Get transactions
tools.description: Returns a page of the authenticated user's transactions. Use get_user_accounts first to discover account IDs, and get_transactions_categories to discover valid category types. Pass pagination.nextCursor as cursor to fetch the next page while nextCursor is present. For CurrencyExchange rows, code KV is a buy of FX and SV is a sell.

accountIds.description: Optional account IDs as UUID/GUID strings. Use get_user_accounts to find valid IDs. If omitted, transactions are returned for all accessible accounts. IDs the user cannot access are silently ignored; an error is returned only when no ID matches.

from.description: Inclusive start date as ISO yyyy-MM-dd. If omitted, no lower bound is applied.

to.description: Inclusive end date as ISO yyyy-MM-dd. If omitted, no upper bound is applied.

categories.description: Optional category types from get_transactions_categories (e.g. Buy, Withdrawal, CurrencyExchange).

instrumentIds.description: Optional instrument IDs as UUID/GUID strings.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's pagination.nextCursor.

tools.name: get_holdings
tools.title: Get holdings
tools.description: Returns holdings for either one account (when accountId is provided) or all accessible accounts. Each account includes currencyPositions: the account's multi-currency cash balances with the amount available for purchase per currency. An empty currencyPositions list means the account holds cash only in its main currency (see the summary). Each position includes loanToValue: the instrument collateral factor as a ratio from 0 to 1 (null if unknown). Use get_user_accounts first to find valid account IDs.

accountId.description: Optional account ID as a UUID/GUID string (e.g. "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6"). Use get_user_accounts to find valid account IDs. If omitted, holdings are returned for all accessible accounts.

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.title: Add to watchlist
tools.description: Adds one or more instruments to an existing watchlist by orderbookId. Use search_instruments to find the correct orderbookId for a ticker or name. Instruments already on the watchlist are silently skipped.

listId.description: The watchlist ID returned by get_watchlists.

orderbookIds.description: OrderbookIds (int) of the instruments to add. Use search_instruments to find the correct orderbookId.

tools.name: search_instruments
tools.title: Search instruments
tools.description: Searches instruments by ticker, name, or orderbookId and returns matching orderbookIds, tickers, and names. Use this tool before create_trade_ticket when multiple instruments have similar names.

query.description: Ticker or instrument name to search for. Required when orderbookId is not provided.

tools.name: create_trade_ticket
tools.title: Create trade ticket
tools.description: Creates a pre-filled trade ticket URL for the Montrose app. Specify side (Buy/Sell), quantity or amount, and an instrument identifier. Use orderbookId directly when known, since it is the safest identifier. If you only know a ticker or name and it may be ambiguous, call search_instruments first to find the correct orderbookId, then call create_trade_ticket. Returns a URL that opens the trade ticket in the Montrose app with the order details pre-filled.

side.description: The side of the order: Buy or Sell.

orderbookId.description: Optional orderbookId (int) to identify the instrument directly. This is the safest identifier and should be preferred when known or after using search_instruments.

ticker.description: Optional ticker (string) to identify the instrument by ticker symbol, e.g. "VOLV B". This is a convenience identifier and may be ambiguous; use search_instruments to find the correct orderbookId when needed.

name.description: Optional instrument name (string) to search for the instrument. This is a convenience identifier and may be ambiguous; use search_instruments to find the correct orderbookId when needed.

quantity.description: Optional number of shares to trade. Exactly one of quantity or amount must be provided.

amount.description: Optional amount to trade. Exactly one of quantity or amount must be provided. If the user explicitly specifies a currency (e.g. "10 000 SEK", "500 USD"), pass it via the currency parameter; otherwise leave currency unset and the currency is resolved from the account's currency positions, falling back to the account's main currency.

accountId.description: Optional account ID as a UUID/GUID string (e.g. "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6"). Use get_user_accounts to find valid account IDs.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. "SEK", "USD", "EUR") for the amount. Set this only when the user explicitly states a currency. When omitted and an accountId is provided, the currency is resolved from the account's currency positions: if the account holds a cash position in the instrument's trading currency, that currency is used; otherwise the account's main currency.

tools.name: delete_price_alert
tools.title: Delete price alert
tools.description: Deletes a price alert (Swedish: "kurslarm") by its id, as returned by create_price_alert or get_price_alerts. Use get_price_alerts or get_price_alerts_for_orderbook first to find the id of the alert to delete.

id.description: The id of the price alert to delete, as returned by create_price_alert, get_price_alerts, or get_price_alerts_for_orderbook.

tools.name: get_price_alerts
tools.title: Get price alerts
tools.description: Returns all price alerts (Swedish: "kurslarm") for the authenticated user across all instruments. Each alert includes the instrument ticker and name, trigger price(s), direction, status, and expiry. Use get_price_alerts_for_orderbook to filter by a specific instrument.

tools.name: get_credit
tools.title: Get credit
tools.description: Returns credit information for the authenticated user's single credit account. Each customer has at most one credit account; do not pass an account ID. Includes the full published interest-rate ladder for the user's price plan (every LTV band, not only the current rate). Fields are null when the user has no credit account or the value is unknown. Use get_user_accounts to find account types and get_holdings for per-position collateral factors and market values.

tools.name: get_watchlists
tools.title: Get watchlists
tools.description: Returns the authenticated user's watchlists with their ID, name, and the number of instruments on each list. Use get_watchlist with a listId to read the instruments on a specific watchlist.

tools.name: get_transactions_categories
tools.title: Get transaction categories
tools.description: Returns the transaction categories that can be used to filter get_transactions. Each entry has a type (pass this as a categories value) and a short description. Call this before filtering get_transactions by category.

tools.name: create_watchlist
tools.title: Create watchlist
tools.description: Creates a new watchlist with the given name for the authenticated user. If a watchlist with the same name already exists, returns that existing watchlist.

name.description: The name of the watchlist to create.

tools.name: create_price_alert
tools.title: Create price alert
tools.description:
Creates a new price alert (Swedish: "kurslarm") for an instrument. Three alert types are supported:
- "price": triggers when the price crosses a fixed threshold. Requires "price". "direction" is optional here: if omitted, it's inferred by comparing "price" to the instrument's last known price (which may be delayed up to ~15 minutes).
- "percentage": triggers when the price moves by a given percentage from a reference price. Requires "price" (the reference price) and "percentage". Optionally "repeating" to re-trigger at each new level. "direction" is optional and defaults to "both" (trigger on a move in either direction) when omitted.
- "trailing": triggers when the price drops X% from its peak (direction "below") or rises X% from its trough (direction "above"), measured from a reference price. Requires "price" (the reference price), "percentage", and an explicit "direction".

orderbookId.description: The orderbookId of the instrument. Use search_instruments to find it.

direction.description: Trigger direction: "above" (alert when price goes above threshold), "below" (alert when price goes below threshold), or "both" (only valid when alertType is "percentage"). Optional for alertType "price" (inferred from the instrument's last known price) and "percentage" (defaults to "both"). Required for alertType "trailing". Set this explicitly to override the inferred/default direction.

validUntil.description: Expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format. The alert will no longer trigger after this date. Optional; defaults to one year from today when omitted.

price.description: Reference/threshold price, required for all alert types. For alertType "price" this is the fixed trigger threshold. For alertType "percentage" and "trailing" this is the reference price the percentage move is measured from (trigger levels are computed as this price × (1 ± percentage/100)). For direction "above" this is the reference for the upper trigger; for "below" the lower; for "both" it is used for both.

percentage.description: Percentage change threshold, e.g. 5.0 for 5% (must be greater than 0 and less than 100). Required for alertType "percentage" and "trailing".

repeating.description: Whether the percentage alert should re-trigger at each new price level. Only applies to alertType "percentage".

preAndPostMarket.description: Whether to include pre-market and post-market prices when evaluating the alert. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get_watchlist
tools.title: Get watchlist
tools.description: Returns the instruments on a single watchlist, identified by listId. Each instrument is enriched with its orderbookId, ticker and name. Use get_watchlists first to discover valid listIds.

listId.description: The watchlist ID returned by get_watchlists.

tools.name: get_price_alerts_for_orderbook
tools.title: Get price alerts for orderbook
tools.description: Returns price alerts (Swedish: "kurslarm") for a specific instrument, identified by orderbookId. Use search_instruments to find the correct orderbookId for a ticker or name. Use get_price_alerts to list all alerts regardless of instrument.

orderbookId.description: The orderbookId of the instrument. Use search_instruments to find it.

tools.name: remove_from_watchlist
tools.title: Remove from watchlist
tools.description: Removes one or more instruments from a watchlist by orderbookId. Returns the orderbookIds that were actually removed; orderbookIds that were not on the watchlist are silently ignored and excluded from the response.

listId.description: The watchlist ID returned by get_watchlists.

orderbookIds.description: OrderbookIds (int) of the instruments to remove.

tools.name: get_user_accounts
tools.title: Get user accounts
tools.description: Returns all user accounts with stable account IDs, display names, and account types. Credit (DEPCR) accounts include credit.usedCredit (drawn credit balance), credit.interestRate (current interest rate), and credit.loanToValueRatio (used credit / pledge-group instrument market value). For all other account types credit is null; a credit account may also have credit null when its credit data is unavailable. Use this tool to discover valid account IDs before calling get_holdings.

prompts.name: credit_guide
prompts.description: Domain guide for credit, collateral, interest tiers, and KF (kapitalforsakring) pledging. Use this prompt when the user asks about their credit account, loan-to-value ratio, interest rates, collateral, or pledging strategy.
